subject.title: feat(discord): add canvas-first Discord Activities support

question: Should Discord Activity support continue in this PR, and if so what permanent Canvas-plugin-owned Activity auth and credential transport model should it use?
rationale: The remaining blockers cross plugin ownership, public Gateway authorization, credential transport, and optional feature scope, so automation can identify defects but should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Rebuild under Canvas plugin auth
options.body: Port the work to the current Canvas plugin route/config contract, require explicit Activity credentials or an approved exchange, remove URL tokens, bound fanout, and then request live proof.

options.title: Pause and restart the feature
options.body: Keep this PR as design context but ask for a fresh branch after maintainers settle the Activity security model and ownership boundary.

options.title: Accept a different Activity boundary
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally approve a different public Activity access model, but the tradeoff should be explicit before any merge.

recommendation.title: Rebuild under Canvas plugin auth
recommendation.body: Port the work to the current Canvas plugin route/config contract, require explicit Activity credentials or an approved exchange, remove URL tokens, bound fanout, and then request live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily about the Canvas plugin and Gateway auth boundary, where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
